CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

9. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 7

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. C — 17
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 8² + 15²
3. c² = 64 + 225
4. c² = 289
5. c = 17
Final Answer: 17 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
